rule YARA_CobaltStrike_Generic_Packed {
    meta:
        author = "SOC_Team"
        description = "Detects generic packed Cobalt Strike beacons - HIGH FP RISK. Use with certificate filtering."
        false_positive_risk = "high"
        reference_hash = "a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2"
        remediation = "Exclude known Microsoft-signed binaries"
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 2E 72 63 64 00 } // '.rcd' pattern in config
        $injection_api = "NtCreateSection" wide ascii
        $c2_mutex = "Global\\MSCTF.Asm.{" wide ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and 
        filesize < 2MB and 
        all of ($$beacon*) and 
        not pe.imphash() == "d7d6c603e91ff9d3c3e4652e9f0bb8b1" and
        not pe.cert_subject() contains "Microsoft Corporation"
}

arguments.summary: A critical APT incident was detected originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), attributed to APT-41 (Double Dragon). The attack began with a phishing email triggering an encoded PowerShell command from Outlook, leading to the execution of a ShadowPad variant via rundll32.exe from the Temp directory. The malware established C2 communication over HTTPS to a known malicious IP (198.51.100.23) and performed lateral movement attempts via SMB. Host-based indicators include mutex 'Global\APT41_ShadowPad_2026' and DNS queries to suspicious domains. The initial alert was triggered by a Cobalt Strike beacon signature, but root cause analysis revealed a more sophisticated payload.

arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious rundll32 Execution from User Temp Directory
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\\rundll32.exe'
    ParentImage|endswith: '\\outlook.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'AppData\\Local\\Temp'
  condition: selection
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/011/
description: Detects potential code execution via rundll32 from temporary directories, often used by malware droppers.
author: SOC Team
